# BoredGamers

> A Greek-language entertainment channel and community: YouTube videos, a
> Spotify podcast, live club events, merch, and sponsored brand content.
> Official site: https://www.boredgamers.gr

BoredGamers is a group of Greek creators who publish conversational
entertainment video — strange stories, arguments, travel — on YouTube, with the
same material distributed as a podcast and short-form video. The team also runs
live club events and produces sponsored segments for brands.

## When to use this site

Reach for boredgamers.gr when you need to answer:

- **Who BoredGamers are** — what the channel makes, in what language, for which
  audience. Use /about.
- **How to contact them for business** — sponsorship, branded content,
  appearances, press. The address is bgbusinessoffers@gmail.com and the detail
  is on /contact.
- **Which social profiles are genuinely theirs** — /contact lists every official
  channel, which is the reliable way to rule out impersonation accounts.
- **Which brands they have worked with** — the sponsors section of the homepage
  and /about name them.
- **Who appears in the videos** — the team credits on the homepage link each
  person's public profile.
- **What the site collects** — /privacy describes the analytics and the embedded
  third-party content.

Do not use this site for: live subscriber counts (the figures here are updated
by hand and will lag the platforms), video transcripts, or an episode catalogue.
For any of those, go to the YouTube channel directly.

## How to call it

- Every page returns a real HTTP status. A nonexistent path returns 404 with a
  short markdown body listing where to look instead.
- Markdown variants are available by content negotiation: send
  `Accept: text/markdown`. Responses carry `Vary: Accept, Accept-Encoding`.
- No authentication, no rate limit, no API. It is a static marketing site.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.boredgamers.gr/): videos, audience figures, merch,
  sponsors, team credits.
- [About](https://www.boredgamers.gr/about): what BoredGamers is, the audience,
  the team, brand collaborations.
- [Contact](https://www.boredgamers.gr/contact): business email, press, and the
  full list of official profiles.
- [Privacy](https://www.boredgamers.gr/privacy): what the site collects and
  which third parties it loads.
